global.pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the ndppd daemon.

interfaces.description: List of interfaces to configure for NDP proxying. Each entry defines how NDPPD should handle NDP messages on that interface.

interfaces[].router.description: Whether this interface acts as a router for NDP (yes/no). Set to 'yes' to respond to Router Solicitations with Router Advertisements.

interfaces[].verbose.description: Enable verbose logging for this interface (yes/no).

interfaces[].rules.description: List of proxy rules defining which address ranges should be proxied on this interface.

interfaces[].rules[].address_range.description: IPv6 prefix or address range to proxy (e.g., '2001:db8:1::/64', '::/0')

interfaces[].rules[].static.description: Whether to use only static neighbor entries for this rule (yes/no). If 'yes', NDPPD will not learn entries via NDP.

interfaces[].rules[].timeout.description: Lifetime (in seconds) for dynamically learned neighbor entries in the proxy cache.
